apps.name: EZCompleteUI
apps.subtitle: AI chat, images, voice and games
apps.localizedDescription:
EZCompleteUI is a native iOS AI workspace with coin-metered chat, a gallery-first image studio, transcription, text-to-speech and ElevenLabs voice cloning, searchable memories, and a custom game creator.

• Persistent chats with local history, file and image attachments, and inline previews
• Image generation and multi-image AI editing from a built-in photo gallery
• Whisper transcription, Apple and ElevenLabs text-to-speech, and a TTS library with audio editing
• AI memory: conversations are summarized and searchable
• BrainRot game creator with saved and community games
• Free coins every 6 hours, with optional coin purchases

An account is required to use the app. Source code and FAQ: github.com/Tweaker177/EZCompleteUI

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new since 7.1.17

### Sound effects and scenes

- Meet **Sounds**: describe an environment, effect, or other sound and generate audio from your prompt. Choose its duration and whether it should loop.
- Browse and play your sounds in a dedicated library, mark favorites, rename, edit, share, and delete them.
- Add a sound to a video or mix it underneath a text-to-speech clip. Reopen the resulting scene in the clip editor to adjust the mix.
- Sounds now has styled menus, improved progress handling, and keyboard behavior that keeps the prompt in view while editing.

### File Explorer

- Explore files and folders inside the app, search the current folder, preview supported documents, inspect file information, and share files.
- Edit supported text and source files with the built-in editor. Read-only handling protects files that cannot safely be edited.
- Work with ZIP, TAR, and supported Debian package archives, including archive extraction and ZIP creation.
- Move files to Trash and restore them when needed. Archive extraction and trash navigation have also been improved.

### Image generation

- Added the Seahorse image generation option, including its account enrollment and reference-image flow.
- Improved handling of reference photos and image attachments so vision requests stay with the intended image workflow.

### Music, chat, and games

- The AI Music library is easier to reach, and its playlist plays through the visible list in order.
- Restored chats and thread titles no longer expose internal formatting wrappers.
- Slot wins now highlight winning lines one at a time with animated symbols. Free-spin rewards also have an updated celebration.

Includes additional fixes, accessibility and localization updates, and improvements throughout the app. Online features require their corresponding services to be available.

## Downloads

- **IPA:** `EZCompleteUI-7.2.0-release.ipa`
- **Deb:** `com.i0stweak3r.ezcompleteui_7.2.0_iphoneos-arm64.deb`

Requires iOS 15…

## What's new since 7.1.12

### AI Music

- Create songs and instrumentals from a description, with optional lyrics, titles, and a Surprise Me option. Track generations in the AI Music library, play, favorite, and share your songs.
- Ask a chat model to create music directly in a conversation. Finished songs appear as playable chat cards and are saved in the music library.
- Generate cover artwork for songs and create replacement covers from the library. Music and speech use a shared player with background playback and lock-screen controls.
- Create soundtracks guided by video visuals and explore improved music, photo, and video workflows.

### Text to Speech and voice cloning

- Add generated background audio to speech by describing a scene or choosing Surprise Me. Mixed clips appear in history; adjust the background level later in the clip editor.
- Refreshed the speech creation, history, and clip editing screens with neon styling, clearer controls, expandable prompts, and copy actions.
- Simplified instant voice cloning and introduced account-based voice slots and retention messaging.

### Chat, memories, and models

- Improved memory search and helper routing, including direct answers and context handoff. Song-producing chat turns can also be indexed as memories.
- Added Flex, Normal, Fast, and Ultrafast response-speed choices in Settings, alongside updates to the available model lineup.
- Added an in-chat thinking indicator and helper-selected reactions, plus improvements to chat playback and response status.
- Select individual messages, code, and images to translate, delete, or export. Export formats include PDF, rich text, and text with original images; selection and export controls have been refined.

### Images, sharing, and more

- Expanded photo editing and Surprise Me recipes, with streaming previews and improved recovery from connection interruptions.
- Added the share extension for bringing supported content into EZCompleteUI, including photo workflow…

## What’s new

- Upgraded the balanced chat model to GPT-6.1 Sol and removed GPT-5.6 Luna.
- Added safer large image batches for chat: attach up to 15 images, with automatic JPEG conversion and only the downscaling needed to stay within the upload budget.
- Added Solidity (`.sol`) and broad common source-file support for chat attachments and iOS Open In.
- Prevented true duplicate gallery images when attaching existing gallery items to chat.
- Added AI-powered gallery analysis and tailored Surprise Me edit recipes.
- Refined the Music Video Workshop audio-attachment prompt to match the app UI.
- Improved TTS clip recovery, library playback, and voice selection.
- Added campaign-segment and marketing-opt-in database migrations.

## Compatibility

- Requires iOS 15.0 or later.
- Includes a signed IPA and a rootless arm64 DEB.

## Gallery
- Add Ask AI a Question to the multi-select menu; all selected images attach to the chat composer.
- Replace the plain system action menu with a themed selected-media card.
- Speed up gallery opening with background indexing, reusable thumbnails, and direct thumbnail decoding.

## Ricochet
- Keep all five main performance controls, including Saturation, visible in one row.
- Dismiss successful high-score name entry automatically so the updated leaderboard is immediately visible.

## Interface
- Restore visible Copy, Speak, and Memories controls in the main chat header.

Added a lot more to the new musical Brainrot game, including a smarrt keyboard, midi drum sequences, more knobs you can control like modulation, compression, high and lowpass, etc.  You can now select the wave type with each synth node, choose square, triangle, sawtooth, sine.  

The game is midi compliant and sends a clock and notes to channel 10.  Use with other midi instruments and it will play the keyboard and drums in other apps.  Pretty cool.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tweaker177/EZCompleteUI/compare/v7.1.4...v7.1.5

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: EZCompleteUI uses the camera to take a one-time selfie for the NSFW image selfie check. The selfie stays on this device and is never uploaded.
privacy.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: EZCompleteUI needs access to your files so you can attach documents, images, and audio to your chats.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: EZCompleteUI uses the microphone for voice dictation.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: EZCompleteUI saves AI-generated images to your Photo Library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EZCompleteUI lets you choose images for your custom Brainrot Slots symbols.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: EZCompleteUI uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice.
